privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: KODA Clothing privacy policy: data collected, cookies, access and deletion rights.
privacy.heading: Privacy,
privacy.s1Text: Email, name and address, only to process your order and send drop news if you signed up. Never sold.
privacy.s2Text: No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers. The site measures its own audience without cookies: a random identifier for the life of the tab, pages viewed and actions (add to cart, search, order), with no IP address or personal data, never cross-referenced or shared. This measurement is exempt from consent under the French CNIL audience-measurement rules. You can opt out below.
